entry.title: New: Resolution 448 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 448-26 - 01/23/26
entry.content:
URGES THE HAWAI‘I STATE LEGISLATURE TO ENSURE THE LONG-TERM SUSTAINABILITY AND FUNDING OF PUBLIC, EDUCATIONAL, AND GOVERNMENTAL (PEG) ACCESS MEDIA IN HAWAI‘I

Seeks statutory protections to ensure PEG Access providers receive no less than three percent of gross cable revenues funded through franchise and access fees paid by cable subscribers.
